verdict.rationale: GitHub's own docs claim 'Ship faster with secure, reliable CI/CD' (Actions), which supports automating deployments, but the evidence pack gives no concrete detail on deployment-specific workflows, and community reports flag recurring Actions outages and historically missing self-hosted runners for orgs, undermining reliability confidence. Missing for 10: detailed deployment pipeline docs/examples, independent hands-on verification of deployment automation, and resolution of the raised reliability/self-hosted runner gaps.
